headline: US Co-Located Solar and Storage Installations Jump to 16 Percent of Total
summary: Co-located solar and storage installations jumped to 16% of all installations, up from 2% in 2017, according to data from the EIA.
why: Growth in co-located energy storage highlights structural shifts in utility infrastructure investment and renewable energy grid integration.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Increased co-location adoption expands market share for renewable storage technologies.
